approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Reproduce a date role borrowed from another exact workflow identity in the same citation and a valid multi-workflow citation rejected as globally ambiguous.
Bind an explicit RFI/Submittal identity, date role and full date inside one statement, or use one unique citation-locator identity when the statement omits the identifier.
Keep ambiguity local to the same workflow identity and date role; unscoped Email or ordinary date claims retain citation-local ambiguity.
Make no provider request, dependency, migration, fuzzy identity merge, date ordering or source-authority rule.
title: Scope date roles to workflow identities
objective: Prevent a cited RFI/Submittal date role from moving to another exact workflow item while allowing independent dates for distinct items.
